messages:
sec-bot: Security alert: vendor hsm-agent v2.4.1 telemetry path -> RCE (CVE-2026-XXXX). Affected hosts: hsm-proxy-1..3. Forensics bundle created.
alex.k: Confirming scope: this agent is our management-side proxy that talks to customer HSMs?
sec-bot: Yes. It performs health checks, fetches vendor updates, and issues management RPCs. Exploit runs as 'hsm-agent' user.
maria_s: Immediate ask to ops: isolate the three proxies, stop agent, and snapshot forensics. Also block vendor update endpoints at the perimeter.
ops-sre: On it. Cordon + snapshoting now, will stop agent process after snapshot. Routing to standby pool. ETA ~8m.
jordan: Two action items for compliance: 1) RBAC review — who can approve vendor updates; 2) confirm agent cannot export CMKs.
paul-crypto: Quick code/log grep: agent doesn't call export APIs. Seen RPCs: GET /status, POST /reload, fetch_update. Example: "[2026-03-21T14:02:11Z] agent rpc=fetch_update src=10.40.2.12". Still, we'll run attestation on key material.
ingrid-legal: If any CMKs touched/exfiltrated, we may have notification obligations. Track affected tenants and timeline carefully.
alex.k: Short RBAC mitigations: create emergency group 'hsm-emergency-fixers', restrict hsm:update_agent to that group, require MFA and signed approval, ttl=4h.
maria_s: Applying temp policy now. Policy ID pol-6212-temp-hsm. Blocking vendor update RPCs via WAF as well.
ops-sre: Snapshots uploaded to s3://forensics/redwood/6212345678/ checksums logged. Agent processes stopped on affected nodes. Failover completed.
paul-crypto: Preparing operator credential rotation steps (operator certs, session tokens). Will not rotate CMKs. Will run attestation and produce signed proof that no key exports happened.
jordan: Increase log retention to 180d for the affected hosts and enable WORM on the forensic bucket. Also add alert for unusual agent outbound connections.
ingrid-legal: I'll draft compliance notification templates and check contract notification windows. Keep external comms on hold until we confirm no CMK exposure.
alex.k: Plan: 1) validate vendor patch in staging canary, 2) keep RBAC lock for 24h after patch, 3) rotate operator creds, 4) postmortem & control updates. Assign owners: maria_s RBAC, paul-crypto rotation, ops-sre forensics/failover, jordan telemetry, ingrid-legal comms.
maria_s: Done: policy pushed pol-6212-temp-hsm. Also adding gating rule: vendor updates must be signed with cert-v3 and scanned by vuln-scan before approval.
sec-bot: Incident ticket created INC-6212-hsm-agent. Forensics link: https://internal/forensics/6212345678
ops-sre: Will update ticket with timeline and attach evidence. If anything new, will notify here. :shield:
